Join Grace from Muckware for private wheel-throwing or hand building pottery classes in the Byron Bay Hinterland. Tailored private workshops to your skill level, whether you're new to clay or looking to build on your skills, this one-on-one session is a personalised class to suit your ambitions and love of clay. Enjoy full use of the studio while you immerse yourself in 2 hours of hands-on ceramic practice. No experience is needed. Come with a project in mind, Pinterest mood board or simply arrive on the day and see what you create. Great for individuals or pairs. #block-8e662a40944b173e61d8 { --stroke-style: none;--stroke-thickness: 6px; } #block-8e662a40944b173e61d8 .sqs-html-content { --tweak-text-block-padding: 6% 6% 6% 6%; --tweak-text-block-padding: initial; } #block-8e662a40944b173e61d8 { mix-blend-mode: var(--tweak-text-block-blend ); border-radius: var(--tweak-text-block-radius); } #block-8e662a40944b173e61d8 { --tweak-text-block-radius: 0px 0px 0px 0px; } #block-8e662a40944b173e61d8 { } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { #block-8e662a40944b173e61d8 { } } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { #block-8e662a40944b173e61d8 .sqs-html-content { } } @media screen and (max-width: 767px) { } What to expect? All tools, aprons, clay, glaze, moulds are supplied.  Wheel throwing - Beginners will learn to create simple cup and ceramic bowl forms. Intermediate and practiced potters can explore advanced shapes like ceramic plates or taller pieces. Grace will handle trimming and glazing. Hand building workshop - You can focus on one large ceramic art piece or create 3 to 5 smaller works. You’ll learn a mix of pinch pot, coiling, and slab-building techniques used in handmade pottery. Pricing Wheel throwing  Each person will have their own wheel. Includes 3-5 wheel thrown pieces. Trimmed, fired and glazed in your choice of glaze.  $350 for 1 person (private session) $220 per person for 2 people (Maximum 2 people per class) Hand building  Includes 1-5 hand built pieces (depending on size) fired and glazed in your choice of glaze.  $350 for one person $220 per person for two people Cancellation policy Rescheduling is available up to 24 hours prior to booking date.
